scope: Explicit benchmark swaps both transport endpoints against pinned reference. Same numerical code/model/recipe/four CPU threads. Two prepared workers per graphics mode; one warmup and three alternating measured rounds. Capture arrays in memory; acquisition, caller decoding and GUI excluded. Nested times overlap; shared workstation, not capacity or stall-elimination proof.
